findings_and_reconnections.classification: source-level conditional correctness/resource contract; independent exact-alias reconciliation pending
findings_and_reconnections.first_contract: A nearest-guide query with fewer than k eligible guides has no occupied-extent or exhausted-candidate exit; its documented empty-result handling is reached only after traversing the full capped search.
findings_and_reconnections.trace: Strands::new(2) admits zero strands. For a nondegenerate one-triangle Surface, Interpolate {count:1, poisson:false, neighbors:4, density:Uniform, patchiness:0, edge:0, ..Default} obtains one root; the edge factor is 1 and it is retained. The guide grid is empty. Interpolate::apply calls nearest_k with k=4 and INFINITY before checking nearest.is_empty. PointGrid caps max_rings at 1,000,000 and visits every ring because found.len() never reaches k. visit_shell enumerates a full (2r+1)^3 cube before filtering each shell. The final ring alone has 2,000,001^3 loop triples. This is finite by source, not mathematical infinity. A supported guide count of 1–3 with neighbors=4 or a group filter that leaves fewer than 4 eligible guides has the same missing early-exhaustion condition.
findings_and_reconnections.connected_support: sim.rs:365-405 independently calls nearest_k(...,4,INFINITY) with count=min(settings.guides,total), which can be 1–3 when total is larger; selected source only, no claim about an ordinary runtime caller or scheduling.
findings_and_reconnections.repair_direction: As a later separate repair, bound search by actual occupied extent or known exhaustion, return fewer than k accepted guides when none more exist, and specify the no-guide behavior at Interpolate. Preserve nearest ordering, filters, unbounded-radius mode and original valid guide selection.
findings_and_reconnections.later_acceptance: After implementation authorization, verify empty, fewer-than-k, group-filtered, ordinary k-present and unbounded-radius cases; establish finite search by occupied inputs. No tests or product behavior were run now.
findings_and_reconnections.historical_relationship: Old q642 / SEGOVB-L11-POINT-GRID-MAX-RADIUS concerns result-radius admission, not this fewer-than-k work path. Earlier e275 READ-077 already inspected the same unbounded calls; bounded exact-term search of available extraction found no specifically described shell-exhaustion case, which does not prove global novelty. Preserve prior e275 attribution and keep aliases open.

findings_and_reconnections.first_contract: turn_between documents a rotation taking direction from to direction to, but treats all nearly zero cross products as identity, including exact opposites.
findings_and_reconnections.trace: With an admitted finite +Y guide normal and −Y sampled scalp normal, one finite guide with points [origin,+Y], neighbors=1 and follow_length=2 has along=1 and smoothstep(0,2,1)=0.5. The requested share is 0.5, but cross=0 and c=-1, so turn_between returns the +Y offset unchanged. Any valid half of a 180-degree rotation that maps +Y to −Y must move this offset away from +Y; the perpendicular rotation axis is ambiguous and needs an explicit policy. A single triangle with consistent −Y normals and a separately admitted guide can supply the represented inputs; no ordinary character or runtime occurrence is asserted.

findings_and_reconnections.classification: conditional admitted-count arithmetic candidate, historically noted as an API case
findings_and_reconnections.first_contract: The public Interpolate neighbors usize can reach PointGrid::nearest_k, which constructs capacity from k+8 without checked arithmetic.
findings_and_reconnections.trace: For neighbors=usize::MAX, count=1 and a surviving sampled root, neighbors.max(1) remains usize::MAX and nearest_k evaluates k+8 before searching. Overflow-checking configurations fail at that addition; wrapping arithmetic produces 7. An earlier positive small root reserve does not exclude the neighbor value. GuideNeighborCount::from_count also admits arbitrary usize and does not fix the arithmetic contract merely by wrapping it.

nonfindings_and_limits: Strands::new asserts >=2 points and push demands exactly that many positions; this excludes the ordinary properly constructed one-point Frizz/Smooth premise. Public Default and mutable independent fields remain the separate q378/q379 admitted-state concerns. A valid empty set is Strands::new(2), not Default.

Vec3::normalize returns the original zero vector when length is zero, so restore_lengths with both corresponding segments exactly zero does not create NaN merely by 0/0. Nonfinite inputs and other numeric policies were not proved safe.

The root displacement is subtracted in both cumulative and noncumulative displace paths. Wave starts point iteration at j=1. Preserving earlier guide locks when reuse is requested is documented; do not classify reuse alone as a stale-cache bug.
Interpolate divergence filtering with finite nearest/reference values retains its first guide against itself; no empty-after-filter finding is claimed solely from divergence.
The exact point-grid finite-radius counterexample cannot by itself prove a changed ordinary hairline result: smoothstep clamps it. Earlier e275 reviewer already documented this.

Groom names from Op::name are stored in GrowReport and printed by Display; Op dispatch is a typed enum match. Serde tag strings and human documentation are text boundaries, not evidence of mutable prose driving classification.

Parting, DensityMask and Op already carry closed roles with payload-bearing enums. Preserve their intended distinctions; bool-like operation options still need explicit per-role semantic review. No derive replacement was established in the selected source.

Ratio and Metres distinguish units without numeric policy; do not assume finiteness, 0..1 or positivity. Frizz.frequency is documented as turns per metre but feeds nonperiodic noise coordinates, so compare TurnsPerMetre versus PerMetre against actual intended semantics before declaring an exact owner match.

DensityMask zero dimensions explicitly produce a uniform mask; Interpolate count zero and GuideMap distance zero have explicit behaviors. Their design policies remain separate from inventing forbidden compatibility fallbacks.
No product source edit, product build, test, fixture execution, product algorithm, simulation, runtime probe, or validation was performed. Existing test source was read only.
